title: Account
influencerLead: Your profile, portfolio and answers, as brands will see them.
brandLead: Your brand profile, as bloggers will see it.
settingsLead: Language, currency, notifications, the app and your password.
preferencesHint: Emails and notifications come in this language. Prices are shown in this currency.
previewNote: This is your profile as a brand sees it. Your contacts open to a brand only after it accepts you.
previewHidden: Brands can’t see your profile yet: it appears to them once it’s verified.
previewBrandNote: Bloggers see this card on each of your briefs. On a confidential brief your name and logo stay hidden until you accept a blogger.
digestHint: New matching briefs or applicants, once a day. Payment and approval emails always arrive.
passwordHint: Changing it signs you out on other devices.
